title: Bregenzerwald · Furkajoch · Faschina Day
slogan: Vorarlberg balcony roads, high meadows and compact pass rhythm.
story: Vorarlberg balcony roads, high meadows and compact pass rhythm. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then ride Faschinajoch high road with something in reserve. The best part sits around Bregenzerwald villages, Furkajoch pass road, Faschinajoch high road, while Dornbirn exit gate and Rankweil food reset keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

waypoints.advice: 1486 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 786 m over the 23 km before it, steadily. Reckon on about 7 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Furkajoch pass road, 27 km on and climbing 275 m.

scenicChapters.title: Bregenzerwald Cheese Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 29 km this is Bregenzerwald Cheese Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Bregenzerwald Cheese Road
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 37 km. 786 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furkajoch
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1761 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
